706.name: Critical Infusion
706.description: Gain vigor when delivering a critical hit.

710.name: Sharper Images
710.description: Illusions inflict bleeding on critical hits.

707.name: Master Fencer
707.description: Grant fury to yourself and nearby allies when you critically strike an enemy.

705.name: Mental Gymnastics
705.description: When you successfully evade an attack, gain vigor.

700.name: Duelist's Discipline
700.description:
Interrupting a foe recharges pistol skills.
This trait can only reduce recharge on enemies with defiance bars once per interval.

1960.name: Wandering Mind
1960.description: Remove a nondamaging condition and gain swiftness whenever you evade an attack.

708.name: Fencer's Finesse
708.description: Gain a stacking ferocity effect when you or one of your illusions strikes with a one-handed sword or an underwater spear. Reduces recharge on sword and underwater spear skills.

692.name: Superiority Complex
692.description:
Your critical hits deal more damage. Critical hit damage against disabled foes, or foes below the health threshold, is further increased.
Disabled foes are affected by stun, daze, knockback, pull, knockdown, sink, float, fear, taunt, or launch.

1950.name: Ineptitude
1950.description:
Interrupting a foe inflicts blind, and blinding a foe inflicts confusion.
This trait can only activate on enemies with defiance bars once per interval.

704.name: Deceptive Evasion
704.description: Create a clone at your current position when you dodge.

839.name: Soul Comprehension
839.description: Your passive life-force generation from nearby deaths is increased. Kills grant <c=@abilitytype>carapace</c>. When you enter shroud, gain life-force per stack of <c=@abilitytype>carapace</c>.

1929.name: Beyond the Veil
1929.description: Take reduced condition damage while at or above the threshold of <c=@abilitytype>carapace</c> stacks.

820.name: Flesh of the Master
820.description:
Minions have increased health. Gain carapace for each minion you control.
Your minions are destroyed when this trait is reassigned.

857.name: Putrid Defense
857.description: Poison damage is increased. Applying poison grants <c=@abilitytype>carapace</c>.

1922.name: Shrouded Removal
1922.description: Lose a condition when you enter shroud and every few seconds while you remain in shroud. Gain <c=@abilitytype>carapace</c> when removing conditions from yourself.

858.name: Necromantic Corruption
858.description:
Minions deal more damage and take conditions from you. When a minion attacks, it transfers conditions to its target.
There is a 10 second cooldown per minion.

860.name: Dark Defense
860.description: Protection reduces incoming condition damage. Gain <c=@abilitytype>carapace</c> and protection when you use a healing skill.

855.name: Deadly Strength
855.description: <c=@abilitytype>Carapace</c> stacks grant power and condition damage.

842.name: Death Nova
842.description: When you or one of your minions is downed, create a Poison Nova. Summon a jagged horror when you kill a foe.

1940.name: Corrupter's Fervor
1940.description: Inflicting a condition on a foe grants <c=@abilitytype>carapace</c>. Gain incoming damage reduction while at or above the <c=@abilitytype>carapace</c> threshold.

1694.name: Unholy Sanctuary
1694.description: Regenerate health while in shroud. If your life force is above the threshold, your shroud will activate if you would take a lethal blow.

1778.name: Invoker's Rage
1778.description: Gain fury when you invoke a legend.

1758.name: Ferocious Aggression
1758.description: All damage dealt is increased while you have fury.

1769.name: Contained Temper
1769.description: Gain energy when you break stun.

1732.name: Cleansing Channel
1732.description: Invoking a legend removes a condition.

1761.name: Rising Tide
1761.description: While your health is above the threshold, strike damage dealt is increased.

1784.name: Glaring Resolve
1784.description: Gain stability and heal yourself when you break stuns.

1774.name: Spirit Boon
1774.description: Invoking a legend grants boons to nearby allies based on the legend that was invoked.

1760.name: Rapid Flow
1760.description: Heal yourself and gain swiftness when you use a skill that has an energy cost.

1781.name: Incensed Response
1781.description: Gain might when you grant yourself fury.

1749.name: Song of the Mists
1749.description: Invoking a legend casts a skill based on the legend you invoked. <c=@reminder>Invoking Razah casts the skill associated with the legend you have equipped in your other slot instead. </c>

1791.name: Charged Mists
1791.description: Invoking a legend while at or below the energy threshold grants extra energy to your new legend.

1719.name: Roiling Mists
1719.description: Critical-hit chance is further increased while you are under the effect of fury. Convert a percentage of your outgoing critical strike damage into healing.

1446.name: Reckless Dodge
1446.description: Damage foes at the end of a dodge roll.

1453.name: Pinnacle of Strength
1453.description: Might applied to you grants more power. Your critical-hit chance is increased.

1447.name: Brave Stride
1447.description: Movement skills grant boons and adrenaline when used.

1451.name: Restorative Strength
1451.description: Using a heal skill grants might.

1444.name: Peak Performance
1444.description: Deal increased strike damage. <c=@abilitytype>Physical</c> skills further increase all outgoing strike damage for a period of time.

2000.name: Body Blow
2000.description: Stuns, dazes, knockbacks, pulls, pushes, and launches inflict vulnerability and weakness.

1338.name: Forceful Greatsword
1338.description: Gain power and a chance to gain might on critical strike. Double these bonuses while wielding a greatsword or underwater spear. Greatsword and underwater spear skills recharge faster.

1449.name: Great Fortitude
1449.description: Gain vitality and ferocity based on a percentage of your power.

1437.name: Berserker's Power
1437.description: Gain increased strike damage when you use a <c=@abilitytype>burst</c> skill; this damage increase is based on your adrenaline.

1454.name: Might Makes Right
1454.description: Gain health and endurance whenever you apply might to yourself.

1440.name: Aggressive Onslaught
1440.description: Gain quickness when you disable an enemy. While you have quickness, your movement speed is increased. <c=@reminder>This stacks with other movement speed increases.</c>

1874.name: Celestial Being
1874.description: Gain access to <c=@abilitytype>Glyphs</c>. Become a celestial avatar once you gain enough astral force. Generate astral force by healing allies and damaging foes.

1862.name: Live Vicariously
1862.description: When you heal an ally, you are also healed.

1992.name: Natural Mender
1992.description: Increase healing to other allies. Gain astral force each interval while not in celestial avatar form.

1868.name: Druidic Clarity
1868.description: Becoming a celestial avatar removes conditions from you and nearby allies.

2016.name: Verdant Etching
2016.description: <c=@abilitytype>Glyphs</c> heal nearby allies. While in celestial avatar form, grant protection instead.

1935.name: Blood Moon
1935.description: Inflict bleeding on enemies you immobilize or disable.

2053.name: Celestial Shadow
2053.description: Grant superspeed and stealth to nearby allies when leaving celestial avatar form.

2001.name: Grace of the Land
2001.description: Grant boons to allies within the radius of your <c=@abilitytype>Celestial Avatar</c> skills.

2056.name: Natural Balance
2056.description: Upon entering and leaving celestial avatar form, deal increased condition damage and increased condition duration for a brief period.

2057.name: Cultivated Synergy
2057.description: When you use a healing skill, heal around your pet and create a water field attached to them. When you combo a water field with a blast finisher, sprout a Lesser Seed of Life at the location.

2058.name: Lingering Light
2058.description:
While in Celestial Avatar form, your healing of others is significantly increased. Healing another player with a Celestial Avatar skill reduces the cooldown of Celestial Avatar.
Cooldown can only be reduced once per outgoing heal and will occur even if the affected player is at full health.

2055.name: Eclipse
2055.description: Your <c=@abilitytype>Celestial Avatar</c> skills are offensively augmented. Striking enemies grants additional astral force.

432.name: Explosive Entrance
432.description: Your first attack when entering combat explodes, dealing damage to nearby foes. This ability refreshes after a dodge roll.

429.name: Shaped Charge
429.description: Deal increased strike damage for each stack of vulnerability on your target.

514.name: Grenadier
514.description: Increase the blast radius of grenades. Using a healing skill casts Lesser Grenade Barrage.

525.name: Short Fuse
525.description: Gain fury when you hit a foe with an <c=@abilitytype>Explosion</c>.

1882.name: Glass Cannon
1882.description: Strike damage dealt increases when above health threshold.

482.name: Aim-Assisted Rocket
482.description:
Missile hits launch a rocket at your target. After enough rockets have been fired, an orbital strike is called instead.
This trait has an internal cooldown.

1892.name: Explosive Temper
1892.description: <c=@abilitytype>Explosions</c> grant stacking ferocity when they hit.

1944.name: Blast Shield
1944.description: Explosive Entrance grants barrier. Gain vitality based on a percentage of your power.

1541.name: Grand Entrance
1541.description: Explosive Entrance grants you resistance and increased critical-strike chance for a brief duration.

505.name: Shrapnel
505.description: <c=@abilitytype>Explosions</c> have a chance to cripple and cause bleeding on hit.

1947.name: Big Boomer
1947.description: Deal increased strike damage to foes with a lower health percentage than you. Hitting with an <c=@abilitytype>Explosion</c> heals you over a few seconds.

1994.name: Physical Supremacy
1994.description: Gain access to physical skills. Your maximum endurance threshold is increased.

1887.name: Weakening Strikes
1887.description: Your next attack after dodging causes weakness to foes struck. Weakened enemies deal less damage to you, and you deal increased strike damage to them.

1837.name: Endurance Thief
1837.description: Gain endurance when you successfully steal from an enemy.

1933.name: Marauder's Resilience
1933.description: Gain vitality based on a portion of your power. Damage is decreased from foes within the range threshold.

2023.name: Escapist's Fortitude
2023.description: Gain health and remove a condition whenever you evade an attack.

1884.name: Staff Master
1884.description: While wielding a staff, gain endurance for each initiative point spent. Gain bonus power, which is increased when wielding a staff.

1893.name: Havoc Specialist
1893.description: Strike damage dealt is increased when your endurance is not full.

1975.name: Impacting Disruption
1975.description:
Recharge steal and inflict a pulmonary impact when you interrupt an enemy.
This trait can only affect enemies with defiance bars once per interval.

1833.name: Lotus Training
1833.description: Your dodge ability now uses Impaling Lotus, firing daggers at nearby enemies. Gain increased condition damage for a period of time when dodging.

1964.name: Unhindered Combatant
1964.description: Your dodge ability is replaced by a long-range dash that removes inhibiting conditions and grants swiftness and damage reduction. Removing certain conditions in this way temporarily reduces endurance gain.

2047.name: Bounding Dodger
2047.description: Your dodge ability is replaced by Bound, dealing damage to the area after you evade. Gain increased strike damage for a period of time after you dodge.

1010.name: Opening Strike
1010.description: You and your pet inflict vulnerability with your first strike when entering combat.

1009.name: Alpha Focus
1009.description: Your opening strikes inflict cripple on your foes.

1011.name: Precise Strike
1011.description: Opening Strike has an increased chance to critically strike.

1021.name: Stoneform
1021.description: Use Lesser Signet of Stone when you use an elite skill. Activating a <c=@abilitytype>Signet</c> grants might and fury.

1014.name: Hunter's Gaze
1014.description: Gain might when you strike a foe based on their health percent.

986.name: Clarion Bond
986.description: Cast Lesser Call of the Wild when you swap pets.

1001.name: Wolfsong
1001.description: Canine <c=@abilitytype>Beast</c> abilities apply vulnerability and reveal nearby enemies. You deal additional increased strike damage against vulnerable enemies.

1000.name: Farsighted
1000.description: Ranger weapon skills deal increased strike damage. Damage is further increased for foes above the range threshold.

1070.name: Moment of Clarity
1070.description:
Gain an attack of opportunity for you and your pet on interrupting a foe. Daze and stun durations that you inflict last longer.
This trait can only grant an attack of opportunity against enemies with defiance bars once per interval.

996.name: Predator's Onslaught
996.description:
You and your pet deal increased strike damage to disabled, defiant, or movement-impaired foes.
Affected conditions are stun, taunt, daze, cripple, fear, immobilize, and chilled.

1015.name: Remorseless
1015.description: Regain opening strike whenever you gain fury. Opening strike deals more damage.

1698.name: Lead the Wind
1698.description: Your longbow and harpoon-gun skills pierce and recharge faster. Point-Blank Shot grants boons.

1757.name: Unwavering Avoidance
1757.description: Gain vigor when successfully evading an attack.

1713.name: Determined Resolution
1713.description: Strike damage taken is reduced by a percentage while you have resolution.

1811.name: Planar Protection
1811.description: Cast Dome of the Mists when you use a healing skill.

1728.name: Close Quarters
1728.description: Reduce strike damage dealt to you from foes beyond the range threshold.

1810.name: Spiritual Reckoning
1810.description: Gain resolution when you use invoke a legend.

1766.name: Set in Stone
1766.description:
Gain protection when you use your profession skill 2.
This trait affects True Nature when you are a herald.

1740.name: Dwarven Battle Training
1740.description:
Deal increased strike damage to weakened foes. Disabling a foe applies weakness.
Disables include stun, daze, knockback, pull, knockdown, sink, float, fear, taunt, and launch.

1779.name: Vicious Reprisal
1779.description: While you have resolution, all damage dealt is increased, and you gain might when you strike foes. Resolution granted to you lasts longer.

1770.name: Versed in Stone
1770.description: Rite of the Great Dwarf reduces damage by an additional amount. When struck below the health threshold, cast Rite of the Great Dwarf. Gain power based on your toughness.

1790.name: Steadfast Rejuvenation
1790.description: Heal every second for each point of upkeep currently in use.

685.name: Illusion of Vulnerability
685.description:
Inflict vulnerability when you interrupt a foe.
This trait can only affect enemies with defiance bars once per interval.

694.name: Dazzling
694.description:
Disabling a foe also applies vulnerability.
Disables include stun, daze, knockback, pull, knockdown, sink, float, launch, taunt, and fear.

1941.name: Fragility
1941.description: Deal increased strike damage for each stack of vulnerability on your target.

686.name: Bountiful Blades
686.description: Improves greatsword skills. Mirror Blade bounces additional times, and Phantasmal Berserker summons an additional berserker and deals less damage.

693.name: Shattered Concentration
693.description: <c=@abilitytype>Shatter</c> skills also remove a boon on hit.

713.name: Egotism
713.description: Deal increased strike damage to foes with a lower health percentage than you.

712.name: Furious Interruption
712.description: Gain quickness when you interrupt a foe.

681.name: Vicious Expression
681.description:
You and your illusions deal increased strike damage. Strike damage is further increased against foes without boons. Disabling a foe removes boons from them.
Disables include stun, daze, knockback, pull, knockdown, sink, float, launch, taunt, and fear.

680.name: Mental Anguish
680.description: <c=@abilitytype>Shatter</c> skills deal more damage. This bonus damage is doubled against foes that are not activating skills.

1688.name: Power Block
1688.description:
Interrupts deal damage and inflict weakness while granting you a damage increase.
This trait can only damage enemies with defiance bars once per interval.

1480.name: Marching Orders
1480.description: Periodically gain Soldier's Focus. Hitting with a burst skill expends Soldier's Focus to grant might to nearby allies.

1485.name: Empowered
1485.description: Deal increased strike damage for every boon on you.

1481.name: Mending Might
1481.description: Applying might to an ally heals you.

1469.name: Leg Specialist
1469.description: Immobilize a target when you cripple them with a skill. Deal increased strike damage to foes affected with movement-impairing conditions.

1474.name: Soldier's Comfort
1474.description: Soldier's Focus heals affected allies and grants them protection.

1471.name: Roaring Reveille
1471.description: Warhorn skills apply additional boons. Your concentration is increased.

1486.name: Warrior's Cunning
1486.description:
Deal increased strike damage to foes above the health threshold. Also deal more damage to foes with barrier.
Damage bonuses do not stack.

1479.name: Shrug It Off
1479.description: Use "Shake It Off!" when you use a healing skill. Removing a damaging condition from an ally heals them.

1482.name: Empower Allies
1482.description: While you are in combat, grant might to yourself and nearby allies each interval.

1667.name: Martial Cadence
1667.description: Soldier's Focus grants boons to affected allies and removes conditions from them. Refresh Soldier's Focus when you swap weapons.

1470.name: Vigorous Shouts
1470.description: <c=@abilitytype>Shout</c> skills heal allies. Gain healing power based on your power.

1711.name: Phalanx Strength
1711.description: When you grant yourself might, grant it to nearby allies as well.

1816.name: Healer's Gift
1816.description: The end of your dodge roll heals nearby allies.

1821.name: Life Attunement
1821.description: Gain healing power. Gain concentration based on a portion of your healing power.

1814.name: Serene Rejuvenation
1814.description: Increase healing to other allies. <c=@abilitytype>Legendary Centaur</c> skills apply boons in an area.

1823.name: Invoking Harmony
1823.description: Healing done to other allies is increased for a short duration after invoking a legend.

1824.name: Blinding Truths
1824.description: Blind nearby foes when you use a healing skill.

1822.name: Eluding Nullification
1822.description: The end of your dodge roll removes a condition from nearby allies.

1819.name: Words of Censure
1819.description:
Blinding, immobilizing, or affecting a foe with crowd control heals nearby allies.
Skills that strike many foes at the same time can heal multiple times.

1817.name: Resilient Spirit
1817.description: Periodically gain barrier for each unique boon you have.

1818.name: Fortified Blessing
1818.description: Grant protection when you remove a condition from an ally.

1815.name: Generous Abundance
1815.description:
Heal allies around yourself when using a Legend skill. Heal allies around Ventari's Tablet when using a Legendary Centaur skill.
Dragon Facet skills and Ventari's Will cannot activate this trait.

1825.name: Unyielding Devotion
1825.description: Take reduced strike damage for a duration after healing. Lasts longer if you heal an ally other than yourself.

1820.name: Invigorating Dismissal
1820.description: Grant endurance when you remove a condition from an ally.

582.name: Valorous Defense
582.description: Gain aegis when you are struck while below the health threshold.

594.name: Steadfast Courage
594.description: Gain protection when you block an incoming attack with aegis.

583.name: Might of the Protector
583.description: Gain might when you block attacks.

588.name: Strength of the Fallen
588.description: Lose conditions every interval. Health degenerates more slowly while downed.

581.name: Smiter's Boon
581.description: Cast Lesser Smite Condition when you use a healing skill.

633.name: Focus Mastery
633.description: Focus skills grant you protection and gain reduced recharge.

580.name: Stalwart Defender
580.description: Gain toughness when wielding a shield, and shield skills gain reduced recharge.

584.name: Redemption
584.description: Cast Lesser Litany of Wrath when you activate Virtue skill 3.

1684.name: Communal Defenses
1684.description: Blocking an attack grants aegis to nearby allies.

585.name: Altruistic Healing
585.description: Heal yourself when you grant a boon to an ally.

586.name: Monk's Focus
586.description: <c=@abilitytype>Meditation</c> skills heal you and grant fury to nearby allies.

589.name: Tenacious Defense
589.description: Aegis you grant reduces the recharge time of Virtue skill 3 when it blocks an attack.

1799.name: Invoking Torment
1799.description: Release a burst of torment energy when you switch legends.

1744.name: Yearning Empowerment
1744.description: Damaging conditions you apply last longer.

1789.name: Demonic Defiance
1789.description: Gain resistance and remove a damaging condition when you use a <c=@abilitytype>Legendary Demon</c> skill.

1741.name: Replenishing Despair
1741.description: Siphon health from nearby enemies when you gain a dark aura. Siphon healing is reduced for each target struck beyond the first.

1727.name: Abyssal Chill
1727.description: When you chill a foe, you also inflict torment on them.

1726.name: Demonic Resistance
1726.description: Incoming strike damage is reduced while you have resistance on you.

1714.name: Pact of Pain
1714.description: Conditions you apply to foes last longer, but conditions applied to you also last longer.

1720.name: Fiendish Tenacity
1720.description: <c=@abilitytype>Invoke Torment</c> grants resistance. Resistance heals you every interval.

1721.name: Permeating Pestilence
1721.description: <c=@abilitytype>Invoke Torment</c> transfers conditions from you onto foes.

1808.name: Expose Defenses
1808.description: Your first attack when entering combat applies vulnerability. This ability is refreshed when you use an elite skill.

1724.name: Destructive Impulses
1724.description: All damage dealt is increased, and increased additionally if you have an off-hand weapon equipped.

1792.name: Targeted Destruction
1792.description: Deal increased strike damage to targets based on their vulnerability stacks.

1776.name: Aggressive Arrival
1776.description: Gain resistance when you invoke a legend.

1767.name: Unsuspecting Strikes
1767.description: Deal increased strike damage to foes with health above the health threshold.

1755.name: Battle Scarred
1755.description: Siphon health after using your healing skill.

1786.name: Assassin's Presence
1786.description: While you are in combat, grant fury to yourself and nearby allies each interval.

1765.name: Notoriety
1765.description: Might grants you more power and less condition damage. Gain might when using a legendary stance skill.

1802.name: Thrill of Combat
1802.description: Gain stacks of <c=@abilitytype>Battle Scars</c> while in combat.

1715.name: Brutality
1715.description: Gain quickness when you swap weapons. Deal increased damage to foes with stability or protection.

1800.name: Swift Termination
1800.description: Deal increased strike damage to foes below the health threshold.

1754.name: Dance of Death
1754.description: Applying vulnerability to foes grants stacks of <c=@abilitytype>Battle Scars</c>. The healing from Battle Scars is increased while you are below the health threshold.

572.name: Justice is Blind
572.description: Gain a light aura and blind nearby foes when you activate Virtue skill 1.

571.name: Renewed Justice
571.description: Virtue skill 1 is renewed when you kill a foe.

568.name: Radiant Power
568.description: Attacks against burning foes have an increased chance to critically hit. Your ferocity is increased.

577.name: Inner Fire
577.description: Gain fury when you strike a foe that has burning stacks over the threshold.

566.name: Right-Hand Strength
566.description: Your precision is increased. Gain increased power while wielding a one-handed weapon in your main hand.

574.name: Healer's Resolution
574.description: Gain resolution when using a heal skill.

578.name: Wrath of Justice
578.description: Striking an enemy with the damaging effect from Virtue skill 1 casts Lesser Signet of Wrath.

567.name: Radiant Fire
567.description: Zealot's Flame is improved. Burning you inflict has increased duration, and your torch skills gain reduced recharge.

565.name: Retribution
565.description: Strike damage dealt is increased while you have resolution.

1686.name: Amplified Wrath
1686.description: Burning you inflict deals increased damage. Burning duration applied by the passive effect of Virtue skill 1 is increased.

579.name: Perfect Inscriptions
579.description: <c=@abilitytype>Signets</c> gain improved passive effects and continue to grant their passive bonuses while recharging.

1683.name: Righteous Instincts
1683.description: Resolution increases your chances to critically strike and grants might each interval.

350.name: Soothing Mist
350.description: You and nearby allies recover health while you are attuned to water.

351.name: Healing Ripple
351.description:
Heal nearby allies when attuning to water.
This effect will not trigger when attuning to the same element, but will be triggered by overload skills.

1676.name: Aquamancer's Training
1676.description: Increase healing to other allies. Water-weapon skills gain reduced recharge.

348.name: Soothing Ice
348.description: Gain regeneration and frost aura when you use a healing skill.

363.name: Piercing Shards
363.description: Vulnerability you inflict has increased duration. Deal increased strike damage to vulnerable foes. Damage bonus is doubled while attuned to water.

360.name: Stop, Drop, and Roll
360.description: Dodging removes burning and chilled from nearby allies.

358.name: Cleansing Wave
358.description: Remove conditions from nearby allies when attuning to water.

349.name: Flow like Water
349.description: Deal increased strike damage, which is further increased while your health is above the threshold. Blocking or evading an attack heals you.

362.name: Cleansing Water
362.description: Cleanse conditions from allies you grant regeneration to.

361.name: Powerful Aura
361.description: Any aura you grant yourself is granted to nearby allies.

2028.name: Soothing Power
2028.description: Gain vitality. Soothing Mist is more effective.

1831.name: Primal Rage
1831.description: Gain access to berserk mode and <c=@abilitytype>primal bursts</c>.

1993.name: Burst of Aggression
1993.description: Gain a burst of speed when entering berserk mode.

2046.name: Fatal Frenzy
2046.description: Berserk mode increases power and condition damage.

2049.name: Smash Brawler
2049.description: When you hit with a <c=@abilitytype>Primal Burst</c> skill, extend the duration of your berserk. Critical-hit chance is increased while berserk.

2039.name: Last Blaze
2039.description: When you use a <c=@abilitytype>rage</c> skill, inflict burning on nearby enemies.<c=@abilitytype>Rage</c> skills extend berserk longer.

1977.name: Savage Instinct
1977.description: Activating berserk mode breaks stuns. Reduce incoming damage for a period of time when entering berserk mode.

2011.name: Blood Reaction
2011.description: A percentage of precision is given as a bonus to ferocity and a percentage of power is given as a bonus to condition damage. These bonuses are doubled in berserk mode.

2042.name: Heat the Soul
2042.description: Grant boons to nearby allies when you hit an enemy with a <c=@abilitytype>Burst</c> skill.

2002.name: Dead or Alive
2002.description: Heal yourself and gain Blood Reckoning when entering berserk mode.

1928.name: Bloody Roar
1928.description: Deal increased strike damage while in berserk mode. Gain resistance when entering berserk mode.

2038.name: King of Fires
2038.description: Increase the duration of burning you apply. Gain fire aura when you critically hit an enemy. Berserker skills detonate fire aura, damaging and burning nearby foes.

2307.name: Eternal Champion
2307.description: Gain stability and endurance when entering berserk mode. Traits that trigger when entering berserk mode also trigger when exiting berserk mode. You can now exit berserk mode early.

792.name: Mark of Evasion
792.description: Leave a Mark of Blood when you dodge.

783.name: Vampiric
783.description: Siphon health whenever you hit a foe. Minions siphon health and transfer it to you.

1931.name: Last Rites
1931.description: As long as you are not downed, allies near you do not bleed out if they are downed. Gain healing power based on your current health.

780.name: Ritual of Life
780.description: Cast Lesser Well of Blood when reviving an ally. Wells of Blood revive allies every pulse.

788.name: Overflowing Thirst
788.description: Dagger skills grant nearby allies Taste for Blood.

1876.name: Blood Renewal
1876.description: Consume conditions to gain health when you use a healing skill.

789.name: Life from Death
789.description: Heal allies in an area when you exit shroud. Increase healing to other allies.

799.name: Banshee's Wail
799.description: Warhorn skills gain increased effect duration.

1844.name: Vampiric Presence
1844.description: You and your nearby allies siphon health with attacks. This effect increases while in Shroud.

782.name: Blood Bank
782.description: Gaining health grants a proportionate amount of barrier. Conversion amount increases while at full health.

1692.name: Unholy Martyr
1692.description: Entering shroud transfers conditions from allies to you. Exiting shroud consumes conditions currently on you and converts them to life force.

778.name: Transfusion
778.description: Marks can be triggered by allies to heal them and provide them with additional benefits. Create Lesser Chilblains at your location when you use your fourth shroud skill.

1294.name: Merciful Ambush
1294.description: Heal when you enter or exit stealth. Stealth yourself and your target when reviving an ally. <c=@reminder>This effect also applies to stealth you grant to allies.</c>

1136.name: Meld with Shadows
1136.description: Gain superspeed when you enter or exit stealth.

1705.name: Shadow Siphoning
1705.description:
Stealth attacks siphon health if they hit.
Cannot siphon the same target more than once per interval.

1160.name: Shielding Restoration
1160.description: Grant barrier and dark aura to nearby allies when you use a healing skill.

1293.name: Shadow's Embrace
1293.description: Remove conditions when you enter or exit stealth. <c=@reminder>This effect also applies to stealth you grant to allies.</c>

1284.name: Hidden Thief
1284.description: Stealing inflicts blindness. <c=@abilitytype>Stealth Attacks</c> inflict weakness. <c=@reminder>Cannot affect the same target more than once per interval.</c>

1297.name: Shadow Savior
1297.description: Gain dark aura when you steal. Granting yourself dark aura heals nearby allies.

1130.name: Leeching Venoms
1130.description:
Venom utility skills siphon life from struck foes. Gain stacks of Spider Venom when you enter or exit stealth.
Siphoning can only occur once per strike.

1300.name: Cloaked in Shadow
1300.description: Gaining stealth blinds nearby foes. Blinding a foe siphons health from them.

1134.name: Cover of Shadow
1134.description: When you steal, create a field around yourself that grants allies protection. Granting dark aura to yourself removes a condition from nearby allies.</c>

1135.name: Shadow's Rejuvenation
1135.description: Gain initiative when you enter or exit stealth.

1162.name: Rending Shade
1162.description: Steal boons from enemies you strike with <c=@abilitytype>stealth attacks</c>. Striking a boonless foe with a stealth attack breaks their barrier instead.

1979.name: Optimized Activation
1979.description: Using tool belt skills grants vigor.

1872.name: Mechanized Deployment
1872.description: Your tool belt skills gain reduced recharge. Tool belt skills remove conditions. <c=@reminder> Engage Photon Forge cannot activate this trait</c>

1936.name: Excessive Energy
1936.description: Strike damage dealt is increased while you have vigor.

532.name: Static Discharge
532.description: Discharge a bolt of lightning whenever you use a tool belt skill.

1997.name: Reactive Lenses
1997.description: Activate Lesser Utility Goggles after using a healing skill.

531.name: Power Wrench
531.description: Reduce the recharge of your elite skill when you dodge.

512.name: Streamlined Kits
512.description: Equipping an <c=@abilitytype>Engineering Kit</c> creates an attack or spell and grants you swiftness.

1946.name: Lock On
1946.description:
Striking a stealthed foe triggers Invisible Analysis.
Disabling a foe triggers Controlled Analysis.
Disables include stun, daze, knockback, pull, knockdown, sink, float, launch, taunt, and fear.

1832.name: Takedown Round
1832.description: Deal increased strike damage while your endurance is not full.

1856.name: Kinetic Battery
1856.description: Gain kinetic charges when you use a tool belt skill. At maximum, charges gain a burst of speed.

523.name: Adrenal Implant
523.description: Endurance regeneration is increased. Reduce the recharge of your tool belt skills when you dodge.

1350.name: Thick Skin
1350.description: Gain protection when you use a healing skill.

1348.name: Adrenal Health
1348.description: Gain health based on adrenaline spent.

1380.name: Hardened Armor
1380.description: Gain resolution when you block or are struck by a critical hit. Strike damage taken is reduced by a percentage while you have resolution.

1376.name: Shield Master
1376.description: Reflect missiles whenever you are blocking. Gain adrenaline when you block an attack or reflect a missile.

1488.name: Dogged March
1488.description: Reduce the duration of movement-impeding conditions and gain regeneration when you are affected by one of these conditions.

1372.name: Cull the Weak
1372.description: Deal increased strike damage to weakened foes. <c=@abilitytype>Burst</c> skills inflict weakness. <c=@reminder>Can only occur once per interval per target for multihit burst skills.</c>

1368.name: Defy Pain
1368.description: Cast Lesser Endure Pain when you use an elite skill.

1367.name: Merciless Hammer
1367.description:
Hammer and mace skills deal increased damage when striking a disabled or defiant foe. Gain adrenaline when you disable a foe.
Disables include stun, taunt, daze, knockback, pull, knockdown, sink, float, fear, and launch.

1375.name: Last Stand
1375.description: <c=@abilitytype>Stances</c> grant vigor and barrier when activated, and they have increased duration.

1649.name: Cleansing Ire
1649.description: Gain adrenaline when hit. Remove a condition when you hit with a <c=@abilitytype>burst</c> skill, then remove an additional condition for every bar of adrenaline spent.

1708.name: Stalwart Strength
1708.description: Gain stability when you disable a foe. Deal increased strike damage while you have stability.

757.name: Mender's Purity
757.description: Cast Lesser Power Cleanse when you use a healing skill.

1852.name: Inspiring Distortion
1852.description: Grant aegis to other nearby allies whenever you give yourself distortion or use Shatter skill 4.

1915.name: Illusionary Inspiration
1915.description:
Increase healing to other allies. Summoning an illusion heals all allies around you.

Virtuoso: Triggers when stocking a blade.

756.name: Medic's Feedback
756.description: Cast Feedback while reviving an ally. Feedback revives allies inside its dome.

738.name: Restorative Mantras
738.description: Heals allies around you when you use a charge of a <c=@abilitytype>mantra</c>.

744.name: Sympathetic Visage
744.description: <c=@abilitytype>Phantasms</c> take conditions from you when summoned.

751.name: Warden's Feedback
751.description: Focus weapon skills reflect projectiles. Reduces recharge on focus weapon skills.

740.name: Ego Restoration
740.description: Create a clone when you use a healing skill.

1980.name: Temporal Enchanter
1980.description: When you cast a <c=abilitytype>glamour</c>, allies near the glamour gain resistance and superspeed.

2005.name: Mental Defense
2005.description: Shatter skill 4 grants boons and breaks allies out of stuns.

1866.name: Restorative Illusions
1866.description: Heal and cleanse conditions from yourself and nearby allies when you use a <c=@abilitytype>Shatter</c> skill.

752.name: Blurred Inscriptions
752.description: <c=@abilitytype>Signets</c> have improved active effects, and activating one grants you distortion.

734.name: Cry of Pain
734.description: Shatter skill 2 inflicts more stacks of confusion for an increased duration.

723.name: Compounding Power
723.description: Creating an illusion increases your outgoing damage and condition damage for a short duration.

721.name: Shatter Storm
721.description: Shatter skill 1 becomes an ammo skill.

1869.name: Persistence of Memory
1869.description: When a <c=@abilitytype>phantasm</c> becomes a clone, it transfers its boons to you.

691.name: The Pledge
691.description: Flame bursts from torch skills inflict additional burning.

722.name: Escape Artist
722.description: When a <c=@abilitytype>phantasm</c> is created, grant it distortion.

729.name: Phantasmal Haste
729.description: <c=@abilitytype>Phantasms</c> spawn with quickness. Gain quickness when you create a phantasm.

733.name: Phantasmal Force
733.description: <c=@abilitytype>Phantasms</c> deal increased strike damage for each stack of might you have. Gain might when your phantasms become clones.

753.name: Malicious Sorcery
753.description: Confusion you inflict has increased duration. When you dodge an attack, inflict confusion on your attacker.

1055.name: Rejuvenation
1055.description: <c=@abilitytype>Beast</c> skills grant regeneration around the ranger.

1056.name: Fortifying Bond
1056.description: When you gain a boon, it is shared with your pet.

1059.name: Lingering Magic
1059.description: You and your pet gain increased concentration. Regeneration you apply is more effective.

1062.name: Bountiful Hunter
1062.description: You deal increased strike damage for each boon affecting you. Your pet deals increased strike damage for each boon affecting it.

978.name: Wellspring
978.description: Grant regeneration to nearby allies when you use a healing skill. You and your pet gain healing power based on power.

1060.name: Allies' Aid
1060.description: Cast "Search and Rescue!" when you begin reviving an ally. Moa pets grant barrier to nearby allies with their <c=@abilitytype>Beast</c> skill.

1054.name: Evasive Purity
1054.description: Dodging removes a condition from you. Heal yourself if you remove a condition this way.

965.name: Spirited Arrival
965.description: Grant boons to nearby allies when swapping pets.

964.name: Windborne Notes
964.description: Grant nearby allies regeneration when you use a warhorn skill. Heal allies when you grant them regeneration.

1038.name: Nature's Vengeance
1038.description: <c=@abilitytype>Spirits</c> slam again when they finish shaking.

1988.name: Protective Ward
1988.description: Cast Lesser "Guard!" when you swap pets.

1697.name: Invigorating Bond
1697.description: <c=@abilitytype>Beast</c> skills heal allies around the ranger.

278.name: Stone Flesh
278.description: Strike damage taken is reduced while attuned to earth.

279.name: Earthen Blast
279.description:
Gain barrier and cripple nearby foes when attuning to earth.
Also triggers on overload skills. Barrier will not be gained when attuning to the same element.

280.name: Geomancer's Training
280.description: Strike damage from nearby foes is reduced. Earth weapon skills gain reduced recharge.

282.name: Earth's Embrace
282.description: Gain resistance after using a healing skill.

1507.name: Serrated Stones
1507.description: Bleeding you inflict has increased duration. Deal increased damage to bleeding foes.

289.name: Elemental Shielding
289.description: Auras you grant to allies also grant protection.

275.name: Strength of Stone
275.description:
Gain condition damage based on your toughness. Inflict bleeding when you immobilize a foe.
Bleeding can only occur on the same target once per interval.

281.name: Rock Solid
281.description:
Grant stability to nearby allies when attuning to earth.
<c=@reminder>Note: This effect will not trigger when attuning to the same element.</c>

277.name: Earthen Blessing
277.description: Decrease the duration of movement-impairing conditions applied to you. Restore endurance when you receive one of these conditions.

1508.name: Diamond Skin
1508.description: Remove conditions from yourself when you successfully combo a field with a leap finisher. Remove conditions from nearby allies when you successfully combo a field with a blast finisher.

287.name: Written in Stone
287.description: <c=@abilitytype>Signets</c> continue to grant their passive bonuses while recharging. Gain an aura when you use a <c=@abilitytype>signet</c> skill.

1674.name: Stone Heart
1674.description:
You take reduced strike damage for a duration of time after entering or exiting earth attunement.
Remaining effect duration is lost when exiting.

1848.name: Virtuous Action
1848.description: The guardian's resolve has further increased, allowing <c=@abilitytype>Virtues</c> to be manifested as physical aspects. Gain access to <c=@abilitytype>Traps</c>.

1896.name: Defender's Dogma
1896.description: Gain vitality. Blocking an attack causes Justice to reach its maximum charge and reduces the cooldown of Spear of Justice.

1926.name: Pure of Sight
1926.description: Deal bonus strike damage based on your distance to the enemy.

1983.name: Dulled Senses
1983.description:
Cripple enemies that you disable.
Disables include stun, daze, knockback, pull, knockdown, sink, float, launch, taunt, and fear.

1911.name: Soaring Devastation
1911.description: Wings of Resolve delivers an attack upon landing. Movement speed is increased.

2037.name: Hunter's Determination
2037.description: Activating your elite skill breaks stuns and grants you endurance.

1835.name: Zealot's Aggression
1835.description: Deal increased strike damage to crippled foes. Justice's passive effect cripples enemies.

1943.name: Bulwark
1943.description: Shield of Courage gains increased radius and duration.

1908.name: Hunter's Fortification
1908.description: Remove conditions and heal when blocking or evading attacks. <c=@reminder>Block and evade triggers have separate cooldowns.</c>

1963.name: Heavy Light
1963.description:
Gain stability when disabling an enemy. Deal increased strike damage to disabled, exposed, or defiant foes.
Disables include stun, daze, knockback, pull, knockdown, sink, float, launch, taunt, and fear.

1955.name: Big Game Hunter
1955.description: Striking an enemy tethered by your Spear of Justice inflicts vulnerability and increases strike damage dealt. Tether duration is increased.

1279.name: Serpent's Touch
1279.description: Stealing inflicts poison. While in the downed state, your attacks apply poison.

1280.name: Lotus Poison
1280.description: Gain might and weaken targets when you poison them.

1257.name: Exposed Weakness
1257.description: Deal increased strike damage to your target for each unique condition on them.

1245.name: Dagger Training
1245.description: Gain bonus power, which is increased when wielding a dagger.

1276.name: Mug
1276.description: Deal damage and gain life when stealing. This attack cannot critically hit enemies.

1164.name: Deadly Ambition
1164.description:
Inflict poison when striking a foe with a dual wield attack. Gain increased condition damage.
Applies poison once per attack use.

1169.name: Even the Odds
1169.description: Apply vulnerability when you steal. Apply conditions when you hit with a stealth attack.

1292.name: Panic Strike
1292.description: Immobilizing a foe poisons them. Striking a foe with unique conditions equal to or more than the threshold immobilizes them.

1704.name: Revealed Training
1704.description: Gain power, then gain extra power while you are revealed.

1291.name: Potent Poison
1291.description: Poison you inflict has increased damage and duration. Other Deadly Arts traits apply additional stacks of poison.

1167.name: Improvisation
1167.description:
Use stolen skills twice. Reduce the cooldown of all equipped utility skills when you steal. If you are a Specter, gain additional shadow force while using Siphon on an enemy.
Cooldown effect will only trigger if all utility slots are filled and if at least one of your active utility skills is on cooldown. Does not affect inactive sequence skills.

1269.name: Executioner
1269.description: Deal increased strike damage when your target is below the health threshold.

468.name: Hidden Flask
468.description: Drink a Lesser Elixir B when struck while below the health threshold.

487.name: Transmute
487.description: Drink a Lesser Elixir C when you use a healing skill.

413.name: Compounding Chemicals
413.description: Heal yourself when you grant yourself a boon. Remove a condition from yourself when you use an <c=@abilitytype>elixir</c> skill. Gain increased concentration.

396.name: Invigorating Speed
396.description: When you gain swiftness or superspeed, you also gain vigor.

509.name: Protection Injection
509.description:
Gain protection when you are disabled.
Disables include stun, daze, knockback, pull, knockdown, sink, float, launch, taunt, and fear.

521.name: Health Insurance
521.description: Increase your incoming healing effectiveness. Gain increased healing to others while using a med kit.

520.name: Comeback Cure
520.description: Grant regeneration when you remove a condition from an ally.

469.name: Boiling Point
469.description: Gain fury when you gain might at or above the threshold.

470.name: Blast Zone
470.description: Create a blast finisher at your location when you use a healing skill's associated tool belt skill.

473.name: HGH
473.description: <c=@abilitytype>Elixirs</c> gain increased durations and grant might.

1871.name: Equal and Opposite Reaction
1871.description: Gain quickness and stability when you disable an enemy.

1854.name: Chain Reactivity
1854.description: Gain barrier when you successfully finish a combo field with a leap or a blast. Every third successful finish grants you might and a larger barrier that is shared with allies.

1080.name: Tail Wind
1080.description: Gain swiftness when swapping weapons in combat.

1083.name: Furious Grip
1083.description: Gain fury when swapping weapons in combat.

1068.name: Hunter's Tactics
1068.description: You deal more damage and have an increased chance to critically strike while attacking from behind or the side or when striking a defiant foe.

1069.name: Sharpened Edges
1069.description: You and your pet have a chance to cause bleeding on critical hits.

1067.name: Primal Reflexes
1067.description: When you successfully evade an attack, gain vigor.

1075.name: Trapper's Expertise
1075.description: Increase the duration of boons and conditions applied by <c=@abilitytype>traps</c>. Offensive <c=@abilitytype>traps</c> inflict cripple.

1016.name: Fang and Claw
1016.description: Feline, avian, and drake pets gain increased precision and ferocity. <c=@abilitytype>Beast</c> skills grant fury around the ranger.

1700.name: Strider's Strength
1700.description: You and your pet gain power. Gain additional power while wielding a sword. Successfully evading an attack grants might.

1846.name: Hidden Barbs
1846.description: Bleeding you inflict is more dangerous.

1064.name: Quick Draw
1064.description: When swapping weapons, gain quickness. The next ranger weapon skill you use will recharge faster.

1912.name: Light on your Feet
1912.description: Damage and condition duration are increased after dodging or using a ranger skill that evades. Short bow skills pierce and gain recharge reduction, and their attacks from behind, while flanking, or against defiant foes are improved.

1888.name: Vicious Quarry
1888.description: Fury grants ferocity and additional increased critical strike chance. When struck while below the health threshold, gain fury.

320.name: Empowering Flame
320.description: Gain power while in fire attunement.

318.name: Sunspot
318.description:
Gain a fire aura, and damage nearby foes when you attune to fire.
Also triggers on overload skills.

319.name: Pyromancer's Training
319.description: Your fire-weapon skills gain reduced recharge. Deal increased strike damage to burning foes.

296.name: Burning Precision
296.description: Burning you inflict has increased duration and your critical hits gain a chance to inflict burning.

328.name: Conjurer
328.description: Gain fire aura when an ally picks up a conjured weapon.

335.name: Burning Fire
335.description: Cast Lesser Cleansing Fire when you have a number of conditions on you.

325.name: Burning Rage
325.description: Sunspot inflicts burning, and its radius is increased. Your condition damage is increased.

340.name: Smothering Auras
340.description: Fire auras have increased duration. Applying auras to allies removes conditions, and transmuting auras removes conditions from nearby allies.

334.name: Power Overwhelming
334.description: While at or above the might threshold, gain increased power. Power bonuses are doubled while attuned to fire.

1510.name: Persisting Flames
1510.description: Fire fields created by weapon skills last longer. Whenever your fire fields hit a foe or you inflict burning, gain increased strike damage for a duration.

294.name: Pyromancer's Puissance
294.description: Gain might for using any skill while attuned to fire. When leaving fire attunement or successfully completing a fire overload, unleash a Flame Expulsion.

1675.name: Inferno
1675.description: Burning you inflict scales off of your power instead of your condition damage.

1900.name: Pack Alpha
1900.description:
Your pet's attributes are improved and pet skills gain recharge reduction.
Improved attributes are power, condition damage, precision, toughness, and vitality.

974.name: Loud Whistle
974.description: While your health is above the threshold, your pet deals increased strike damage. Your pet swap gains recharge reduction.

1065.name: Pet's Prowess
1065.description: Your pet moves faster and deals more damage on critical hits.

1861.name: Go for the Eyes
1861.description: Nearby foes are blinded by <c=@abilitytype>Beast</c> abilities.

1072.name: Natural Healing
1072.description: Your pet recovers health each interval.

1606.name: Resounding Timbre
1606.description:
Commands copy boons from yourself to your pet.
Soulbeast: when merged, extend the duration of boons on yourself instead.

975.name: Wilting Strike
975.description:
Beast abilities inflict weakness on those struck.
This effect will only occur once on each target struck by an ability.

1047.name: Bestial Rage
1047.description: Gain might and fury when you disable a foe.

970.name: Honed Axes
970.description: You and your pet gain ferocity. Axe skills gain reduced recharge, and you gain additional ferocity while wielding an axe.

1945.name: Beastly Warden
1945.description: <c=@abilitytype>Beast</c> abilities taunt nearby foes. Ursine and porcine pets deal increased damage and have increased health.

968.name: Zephyr's Speed
968.description: Cast Lesser Quickening Zephyr when you swap pets.

1066.name: Go for the Throat
1066.description: When you strike an enemy with a <c=@abilitytype>Beast</c> ability, cast Lesser "Sic 'Em!" on the enemy.

1090.name: Companion's Defense
1090.description: You and your pet gain protection when you dodge roll.

1089.name: Rugged Growth
1089.description: You and your pet recover health while affected by protection.

1098.name: Child of Earth
1098.description: Create muddy terrain when you use a healing skill.

1086.name: Oakheart Salve
1086.description: Gain regeneration when you are inflicted with bleeding, poison, or burning. While you have regeneration, you take reduced strike damage.

1099.name: Arachnophobia
1099.description: Spider pet's Spit and devourer pet's Twin Darts additionally inflict torment. You and your pet gain expertise; spiders and devourers gain more.

1101.name: Ambidexterity
1101.description: Gain condition damage. Gain additional condition damage while wielding a torch, dagger, or mace. Torch and dagger skills recharge faster.

2032.name: Survival Instincts
2032.description: Gain increased outgoing strike damage and reduced incoming strike damage. When above the health threshold, outgoing strike damage is further increased. When below the health threshold, incoming strike damage is further reduced.

1100.name: Empathic Bond
1100.description: Remove conditions when you swap pets.

1094.name: Carnivore
1094.description:
Steal health from enemies when you or your pet disable them.
Disables include stun, daze, knockback, pull, knockdown, sink, float, launch, taunt, and fear.

1699.name: Wilderness Knowledge
1699.description: <c=@abilitytype>Survival</c> skills grant fury and remove conditions.

1701.name: Poison Master
1701.description: Upon using a <c=@abilitytype>Beast</c> ability, your pet's next attack will inflict poison; your poison damage is increased.

1905.name: Shroud Knight
1905.description: Death Shroud is replaced with Reaper's Shroud, which has more melee-oriented skills and consumes life force at a faster rate. Gain access to shouts.

1879.name: Shivers of Dread
1879.description: Whenever you inflict fear, you also chill. Chill lasts longer.

2018.name: Cold Shoulder
2018.description: Chilled foes take increased strike damage from your attacks and deal less strike damage to you.

1974.name: Augury of Death
1974.description: <c=@abilitytype>Shouts</c> now siphon health. This effect is increased on foes in melee range.

2020.name: Chilling Nova
2020.description: Critical hits against chilled foes cause an explosion that chills adjacent foes.

2026.name: Relentless Pursuit
2026.description: Reduces duration of movement-impairing conditions. Additional reduction while in reaper's shroud.

1969.name: Soul Eater
1969.description: Striking foes within the range threshold deals increased strike damage and heals you for a portion of the damage dealt.

2008.name: Chilling Victory
2008.description:
Striking a chilled foe grants might and life force.
Single attacks can activate this trait more than once before recharging.

2031.name: Decimate Defenses
2031.description: Striking a foe with vulnerability increases your critical hit chance.

1932.name: Blighter's Boon
1932.description: Gain life force and health when you apply a boon to yourself or remove a boon from an enemy.

2021.name: Reaper's Onslaught
2021.description:
Gain ferocity and quickness while in Reaper's Shroud. Hitting with Life Reap reduces the recharge time of shroud skills.
Recharge reduction can only occur once per use of Life Reap.

1281.name: Keen Observer
1281.description: Critical-hit chance is increased, and it is further increased while your health is above the threshold.

1210.name: Unrelenting Strikes
1210.description: Grant fury to yourself and nearby allies when you critically strike an enemy.

1282.name: Ferocious Strikes
1282.description: Gain increased critical damage against foes whose health is above the threshold.

1209.name: Assassin's Fury
1209.description: Gain might when you gain fury.

1268.name: Twin Fangs
1268.description: Deal increased critical damage, which is further increased while your health is above the threshold. Gain bonus critical-hit chance when hitting a foe from behind or the side or when they are defiant.

1170.name: Sundering Shade
1170.description: <c=@abilitytype>Stealth Attack</c> skills inflict vulnerability and grant fury upon successfully hitting foes.

1272.name: Practiced Tolerance
1272.description: Gain ferocity based on your precision.

1299.name: Deadly Aim
1299.description: Your pistol and harpoon gun attacks now pierce and have increased strike damage.

1904.name: No Quarter
1904.description: Landing a critical hit while under the effects of fury increases the duration of fury. Gain increased ferocity while under the effects of fury.

1215.name: Hidden Killer
1215.description: Gain bonus critical-hit chance while stealthed. This bonus lingers for a short duration after you've been revealed.

1702.name: Invigorating Precision
1702.description: You are healed for a percentage of outgoing critical-hit damage. This healing is increased while you are under the effects of fury.

1342.name: Furious Burst
1342.description: Gain fury when you swap weapons. Fury gives an increased critical chance.

1343.name: Deep Strikes
1343.description: Gain condition damage when you have fury. You have increased chance to critically strike against bleeding foes.

1337.name: Bloodlust
1337.description: You have a chance to inflict bleeding on critical hits, and bleeds that you apply last longer.

1455.name: Wounding Precision
1455.description: Gain expertise based on your precision.

1344.name: Signet Mastery
1344.description: <c=@abilitytype>Signets</c> grant a stacking ferocity boon on use. Cast Lesser Signet of Might when striking a foe below the health threshold.

1334.name: Opportunist
1334.description: Gain fury and adrenaline when you immobilize or disable a foe.

1315.name: Unsuspecting Foe
1315.description:
Increased critical-hit chance against disabled or defiant foes.
Disables include stun, daze, knockback, pull, knockdown, sink, float, launch, taunt, and fear.

1316.name: Sundering Burst
1316.description:
Burst skills inflict vulnerability if they hit and inflict additional vulnerability if the attack is a critical hit.
Can only occur once per interval per target for multihit burst skills.

1333.name: Blademaster
1333.description: Gain expertise. Gain condition damage while wielding a sword. Sword skills gain reduced recharge.

1336.name: Burst Precision
1336.description: <c=@abilitytype>Burst</c> skills have an increased critical chance. Gain bonus critical-hit chance and ferocity for a duration when you hit with a burst skill. Duration is based on adrenaline spent.

1346.name: Furious
1346.description: Critical hits grant bonus adrenaline and gain a stacking condition damage effect.

1707.name: Dual Wielding
1707.description: Attack speed is increased when wielding a main-hand weapon in your off hand. Heal when you critically strike a foe while wielding a main-hand weapon in your off hand. This heal is increased when critically striking a bleeding foe.

268.name: Arcane Prowess
