2128.name: Leader of the Pack
2128.description: <c=@abilitytype>Stance</c> skills gain increased duration on you and grant their effects to nearby allies for a reduced duration.

2143.name: Oppressive Superiority
2143.description: Deal increased strike damage to foes at a lower health percentage than you. Conditions you apply to foes at a lower health percentage than you last longer.

2109.name: Weaver
2109.description: Your active attunement is now applied to your main hand, with the old attunement moving to your off hand. Attunement recharges are reduced. Gain access to <c=@abilitytype>Dual Attack</c> and the <c=@abilitytype>Stance</c> utility types.

2077.name: Elemental Refreshment
2077.description: Gain vitality. Grant barrier to yourself when using Dual Attack skills.

2081.name: Elemental Polyphony
2081.description: Gain attributes based on your current attunement. When dual attuned, gain both benefits.

2177.name: Superior Elements
2177.description: <c=@abilitytype>Dual Attack</c> skills weaken enemies. Attacks against weakened foes have increased critical chance.

2165.name: Elemental Pursuit
2165.description:
Swiftness on you is improved. Gain swiftness when you disable an enemy.
Disables include stun, daze, knockback, pull, knockdown, sink, float, launch, taunt, and fear.

2115.name: Weaver's Prowess
2115.description: Gain resistance when you attune to a single element.

2061.name: Swift Revenge
2061.description: <c=@abilitytype>Dual Attacks</c> grant you additional bonuses based on their elements.

2170.name: Bolstered Elements
2170.description: Gain protection when activating a <c=@abilitytype>Stance</c>. Activate Lesser Stone Resonance when using an elite skill.

2131.name: Elements of Rage
2131.description: Gain a bonus to all damage dealt for a period of time when attuned to a single element. Gain access to Unravel.

2090.name: Woven Stride
2090.description: Gain regeneration and cleanse a condition when you grant yourself either swiftness or superspeed.

2138.name: Flow State
2138.description:
Your attunements and Dual Attack skills gain reduced recharge.
This attunement recharge reduction will not take effect while Weave Self is active.

2158.name: Photon Projector
2158.description: Photon Forge replaces your tool belt skill 5. Gain access to <c=@abilitytype>Exceed</c> skills.

2135.name: Heat Therapy
2135.description:
Gain health per unit of heat lost.
This trait does not function while cooling due to an overheat unless Photonic Blasting Module is equipped.

2122.name: Laser's Edge
2122.description: While Photon Forge is active, your outgoing strike damage is increased based on your current heat.

2114.name: Light Density Amplifier
2114.description: Photon Forge reduces incoming damage but has increased passive heat generation.

2157.name: Prismatic Converter
2157.description: Deactivate Photon Forge converts conditions into boons based on your heat level.

2106.name: Solar Focusing Lens
2106.description: Your first few attacks after entering or exiting Photon Forge inflict burning and deal increased strike damage. This bonus is also granted if you overheat.

2103.name: Crystal Configuration: Storm
2103.description: Photon Forge skill 1 now fires explosive projectiles, but generates extra heat.

2152.name: Crystal Configuration: Eclipse
2152.description: Corona Burst grants a barrier for each target struck.

2091.name: Crystal Configuration: Zephyr
2091.description: Holo Leap removes movement-impairing conditions, grants superspeed instead of swiftness, and inflicts cripple.

2066.name: Thermal Release Valve
2066.description:
Dodge rolling vents heat as an attack against nearby foes and grants vigor.
(Attack will not occur without heat.)

2137.name: Enhanced Capacity Storage Unit
2137.description: Increases maximum heat capacity. While above 100% heat, periodically gain might. Some skills and traits gain additional heat tiers.

2064.name: Photonic Blasting Module
2064.description:
Overheat now blasts damage to nearby foes and no longer deals its initial damage to you. The tool belt recharge penalty for Overheat is reduced. Heat can only be lost after overheating.
Damage over time from Overheat is still applied.

2171.name: Deadeye's Gaze
2171.description: Steal is replaced with Deadeye's Mark, which unlocks new Stolen skills and malice generation. Stealth attacks consume malice for bonus effects. Gain access to rifles and cantrips.

2172.name: Renewing Gaze
2172.description: Deadeye's Mark recharges if your mark is defeated. Gain regeneration when this recharge occurs.

2084.name: Iron Sight
2084.description: Strike damage dealt to your marked target is increased, and strike damage taken from your marked target is reduced.

2145.name: Malicious Intent
2145.description: Marking a target or striking your mark with a stealth attack will immediately grant malice.

2173.name: Collateral Damage
2173.description: Trigger Burst of Shadows at your target's location if it dies while marked.

2136.name: One in the Chamber
2136.description:
When you cast a cantrip, gain a random new stolen skill. Stolen skills deal more damage.
(Requires a marked target. Overwrites existing stolen skills.)

2118.name: Silent Scope
2118.description: Gain precision. When you dodge roll, gain access to your stealth attack if your malice is above the threshold.

2078.name: Payback
2078.description:
When Renewing Gaze triggers, this trait restores a portion of the recharge time needed by your healing, utility, and elite skills.
Excludes racial skills.

2160.name: Premeditation
2160.description: Deal increased strike damage for each unique boon you have; concentration is increased.

2111.name: Maleficent Seven
2111.description: Increase the maximum malice-stack count. Restore initiative and gain boons upon reaching the maximum number of malice stacks.

2093.name: Be Quick or Be Killed
2093.description: Gain quickness when marking a foe. Your power and precision are increased while under this effect.

2146.name: Fire for Effect
2146.description: Using a stolen skill grants additional boons to allies around you. Stolen skills will always be Steal Time, regardless of the target's profession.

2150.name: Mirage Cloak
2150.description: Gain Mirage Cloak instead of dodge rolling. <c=@abilitytype>Ambush</c> skills become available for a short time whenever you gain Mirage Cloak. Gain access to <c=@abilitytype>Deception</c> skills.

2069.name: Nomad's Endurance
2069.description: <c=@abilitytype>Shatter</c> skills give vigor. Strike and condition damage dealt is increased when you have vigor.

2117.name: Speed of Sand
2117.description: Mirage Cloak increases your movement speed.

2141.name: Self-Deception
2141.description: Using a <c=@abilitytype>Deception</c> skill will create a clone if you have any other clones active.

2082.name: Renewing Oasis
2082.description: Gain regeneration when you gain Mirage Cloak. The duration of incoming damaging conditions is reduced while you are regenerating.

2110.name: Riddle of Sand
2110.description: When entering combat, your first <c=@abilitytype>Ambush</c> attack applies confusion. This ability refreshes when you use a <c=@abilitytype>Shatter</c> skill.

2178.name: Desert Distortion
2178.description: Illusions shattered by Distortion become Mirage Mirrors. <c=@abilitytype>Ambush</c> skills become available for a short time whenever you grant distortion to yourself.

2174.name: Mirage Mantle
2174.description: <c=@abilitytype>Ambush</c> skills you use grant boons to nearby allies.

2098.name: Phantom Pain
2098.description: Gain a damage increase when you use a <c=@abilitytype>Shatter</c> skill, increasing per clone shattered.

2070.name: Infinite Horizon
2070.description: When you gain Mirage Cloak, your illusions also gain it.

2113.name: Elusive Mind
2113.description: Lose conditions when you gain Mirage Cloak.

2169.name: Dune Cloak
2169.description: <c=@abilitytype>Shatter</c> skills grant Mirage Cloak if you have enough clones present. Gaining Mirage Cloak recharges Mind Wrack and Cry of Frustration.

2147.name: Mantle of Sand
2147.description:
Gain the power to craft sand shadows and command them using your life force. Gain access to Punishment and Shade skills.
Shade skills inherit the effects of traits that affect shroud skills.

2121.name: Sand Sage
2121.description: Gain concentration and expertise when you have an active shade.

2096.name: Blood as Sand
2096.description: Reduce all incoming damage taken when you have a shade active.

2167.name: Abrasive Grit
2167.description:
Granting an ally a barrier removes conditions afflicting them and grants might.
This effect only occurs with barrier from scourge skills and traits.

2074.name: Fell Beacon
2074.description: Burning you inflict does more damage. Gain expertise based on your condition damage.

2102.name: Nourishing Ashes
2102.description: Gain life force when you inflict burning, and remove or corrupt a boon.

2059.name: Feed from Corruption
2059.description: When you remove or corrupt a boon from an enemy, gain barrier.

2067.name: Sadistic Searing
2067.description: Nefarious Favor now burns nearby enemy targets.

2112.name: Sand Savant
2112.description:
Summon only one shade at a time. This greater shade has a modified recharge. Influence a larger area with shade skills.
A greater shade counts as three shades for related traits.

2164.name: Demonic Lore
2164.description:
Torment you inflict deals increased damage and causes your foes to burn.
This trait can only inflict burning on a particular target once every three seconds.

2080.name: Desert Empowerment
2080.description:
Manifest Sand Shade grants a barrier to allies near it. When you apply barrier, grant boons to the affected target.
This effect only occurs with barrier from scourge skills and traits.

2175.name: Spellbreaker's Conviction
2175.description: Maximum adrenaline is capped at 2 bars, and only level 1 bursts are available. Gain access to the Full Counter burst and <c=@abilitytype>Meditation</c> skills.

2162.name: Dispelling Force
2162.description: Dazes, stuns, pulls, knockdowns, knockbacks, and launches remove boons.

2130.name: Attacker's Insight
2130.description:
Gain Insight when disabling foes or removing boons. Full Counter refreshes all burst skills on hit.
Disables include stun, daze, knockback, pull, knockdown, sink, float, launch, taunt and fear.

2107.name: Pure Strike
2107.description: Deal increased critical-hit damage. This bonus is doubled against boonless foes.

2153.name: Guard Counter
2153.description: Gain protection after a successful Full Counter.

2126.name: Loss Aversion
2126.description: Removing boons from a foe deals damage and gives you adrenaline.

2095.name: Sun and Moon Style
2095.description:
Gain bonuses for each dagger you equip:
Main hand—Strike damage is increased versus foes with no boons.
Off hand—Heal for a percent of your outgoing strike damage.

2163.name: Enchantment Collapse
2163.description: Removing a boon from a foe causes all nearby foes to lose additional boons.

2168.name: Resolute Counter
2168.description: Full Counter heals and removes conditions from you.

2060.name: Magebane Tether
2060.description: Hitting with a <c=@abilitytype>burst</c> skill casts Magebane Tether on your target if they are within range.

2089.name: Purity of Word
2089.description:
Gain knowledge of Elonian lore, igniting a fierce drive to purge corruption and manifesting your Virtues as mystic tomes. Gain access to Mantras.
Using Tome skills consumes pages. You regenerate pages every interval.

2062.name: Swift Scholar
2062.description:
Equipping a Virtue grants you quickness. Every third Tome skill grants you pages.
Stacks reset when exiting a tome.
Quickness can only be gained once per interval

2148.name: Imbued Haste
2148.description: Gain increased attributes while affected by quickness.

2075.name: Unrelenting Criticism
2075.description: Axe skills gain a chance to inflict bleeding.

2101.name: Liberator's Vow
2101.description: Grant allies quickness when you use your heal skill.

2063.name: Weighty Terms
2063.description: The final charge of your <c=@abilitytype>Mantra</c> skills will slow nearby foes and grant you pages.

2076.name: Stalwart Speed
2076.description:
When you grant aegis or stability, grant quickness.
This can affect multiple targets simultaneously.

2116.name: Legendary Lore
2116.description: <c=@abilitytype>Tome</c> skills gain bonuses from scribbling in the margins by ancient bards.

2105.name: Stoic Demeanor
2105.description:
Retain Courage passive while it is on cooldown. Grant boons to nearby allies when you disable, immobilize, or slow an enemy.
Disables include stun, daze, knockback, pull, knockdown, sink, float, launch, taunt, and fear.

2179.name: Quickfire
2179.description: Retain <c=@abilitytype>Justice</c> passive while it is on cooldown. Granting quickness to an ally also grants Ashes of the Just.

2159.name: Loremaster
2159.description: Retain <c=@abilitytype>Resolve</c> passive while it is on cooldown. You generate pages more quickly.

2181.name: Ambush Commander
2181.description:
When you critically strike, attack your enemies from behind or their flanks, or strike a defiant foe, you'll inspire yourself with Kalla's Fervor.
Gain access to Citadel Order skills.

2154.name: Endless Enmity
2154.description: Grant fury to yourself and nearby allies when you critically strike a foe.

2142.name: Brutal Momentum
2142.description: Gain increased critical-hit chance. This bonus is increased further while your endurance is full. Gain vigor when you gain fury.

2166.name: Ashen Demeanor
2166.description: Gain might, resistance, and Kalla's Fervor when you use a healing skill.

2079.name: Blood Fury
2079.description: Fury increases the duration of bleeds you inflict. Gaining fury inspires you with Kalla's Fervor.

2120.name: Wrought-Iron Will
2120.description: Evading an attack inspires you with Kalla's Fervor and grants boons to nearby allies.

2092.name: Heartpiercer
2092.description: Bleeding you inflict deals more damage. Deal increased strike damage to bleeding foes.

2108.name: All for One
2108.description: When you trigger <c=@abilitytype>Band Together</c>, gain energy and reduce the recharge of the enhanced skill.

2094.name: Vindication
2094.description: Kalla's Fervor causes you to heal for a percentage of your outgoing damage. Citadel Bombardment dazes enemies the first time that it strikes them.

2100.name: Lasting Legacy
2100.description: Kalla's Fervor you inspire lasts longer and is more potent. Heroic Command grants more might per stack of Kalla's Fervor.

2182.name: Righteous Rebel
2182.description: Kalla's Fervor increases your healing to other allies. Orders from Above lasts longer, heals allies, and affects a larger area.

2183.name: Dark Disciple
2183.description:
Death Shroud is replaced with Harbinger Shroud, granting powerful offensive skills but leaving you vulnerable to attack.
As you remain in Harbinger Shroud, you accumulate stacking Blight.
Blight decreases your maximum health.

2186.name: Alchemic Vigor
2186.description: Gain increased vitality. Heal each second for each stack of blight you have.

2217.name: Corrupted Talent
2217.description: Gain life force when you enter Harbinger Shroud.

2188.name: Wicked Corruption
2188.description: Deal increased strike damage for each stack of blight you have. Critical strikes deal increased damage to targets with torment.

2185.name: Septic Corruption
2185.description: Deal increased condition damage for each stack of blight you have. Shroud skill 2 also inflicts poison.

2192.name: Implacable Foe
2192.description: Gain stability and damage reduction when entering Harbinger Shroud. Gain ferocity based on your vitality.

2220.name: Twisted Medicine
2220.description: Elixir skills also grant their boons to allies within the elixir impact radius. Gain concentration based on your vitality.

2209.name: Dark Gunslinger
2209.description: Pistol skills gain reduced recharge. Gain expertise based on your vitality.

2218.name: Cascading Corruption
2218.description: Gain Cascading Corruption stacks when you consume Blight. When you reach the stack threshold, explode necrotic energy and increase your damage for a duration. <c=@reminder>Stacks can only be gained in combat and are lost upon leaving combat.</c>

2194.name: Deathly Haste
2194.description: Grant boons to nearby allies when you enter Harbinger Shroud and when you use Dark Barrage.

2203.name: Doom Approaches
2203.description: Blight reduces more of your health and accumulates faster while in shroud. Your shroud skills are improved.

2200.name: Willbender Training
2200.description: The guardian's Virtues are now movement based, giving them a swift advantage in combat. Gain access to the Physical skill type.

2222.name: Righteous Sprint
2222.description: Gain increased movement speed. Gain swiftness when you activate a virtue.

2189.name: Lethal Tempo
2189.description: Each time you activate a virtue or your virtue's passives are triggered, gain a damage bonus. Gaining stacks of this boon refreshes other stacks.

2191.name: Searing Pact
2191.description: Gain condition damage. <c=@abilitytype>Willbender Flames</c> now inflict burning on foes they strike.

2190.name: Power for Power
2190.description: Gain increased power. <c=@abilitytype>Willbender Flames</c> deal increased damage to foes they strike.

2187.name: Conceited Curate
2187.description: Gain increased vitality. <c=@abilitytype>Willbender Flames</c> now heal you when they strike an enemy.

2197.name: Restorative Virtues
2197.description: Triggered virtue effects reduce the cooldown of active weapon abilities. Gain vigor when activating Flowing Resolve.

2210.name: Holy Reckoning
2210.description: Triggered virtue effects now grant might to allies in addition to their bonuses. Gain fury when activating Rushing Justice.

2199.name: Vanguard Tactics
2199.description: Activating Crashing Courage grants resistance. Shadowstepping grants resolution and protection.

2195.name: Phoenix Protocol
2195.description: Gain boons when resolve's effect triggers, but you no longer heal. Resolve has a modified duration. Gain boons when you use Flowing Resolve.

2201.name: Tyrant's Momentum
2201.description: Lethal Tempo grants increased damage, but has reduced duration. Justice's duration is modified.

2198.name: Deathless Courage
2198.description: While Courage is active, incoming strike damage and condition damage is reduced.

2216.name: Psychic Blades
2216.description:
Whenever a clone would be summoned, you instead stock a blade. Blades persist indefinitely until used. Your shatters are replaced with Bladesongs that consume your stocked blades, but still count as shatters for the purposes of core traits.

While out of combat, you will automatically stock a blade every 10 seconds.

2204.name: Deadly Blades
2204.description: <c=@abilitytype>Blades</c> inflict vulnerability on critical hits. After successfully casting a <c=@abilitytype>Bladesong</c>, increase all damage dealt for a short time. This does not stack.

2193.name: Quiet Intensity
2193.description: Fury gives an increased critical hit chance. Gain ferocity based on your vitality.

2208.name: Mental Focus
2208.description: Strike damage is increased against foes within the range threshold.

2202.name: Jagged Mind
2202.description: <c=@abilitytype>Blade</c> attacks inflict bleeding on critical hits. A percentage of your condition damage dealt heals you.

2215.name: Duelist's Reversal
2215.description: Blocking or dodging an attack grants boons.

2205.name: Phantasmal Blades
2205.description: Phantasms that successfully complete their attack launch a blade at their target and grant you fury when they expire.

2207.name: Sharpening Sorrow
2207.description: Gain fury when you activate Bladesong Sorrow. Fury increases your expertise.

2211.name: Psychic Riposte
2211.description: Blocking or evading an attack stocks <c=@abilitytype>blades</c>. Dodging stocks a blade.

2206.name: Infinite Forge
2206.description: Automatically stock <c=@abilitytype>blades</c> while in combat. When you use a <c=@abilitytype>bladesong</c> above the blade threshold, refund <c=@abilitytype>blades</c>. <c=@abilitytype>Blade</c> attacks deal more damage.

2223.name: Bloodsong
2223.description: Bleeding you apply deals increased damage. Stock a <c=@abilitytype>blade</c> after applying enough stacks of bleeding to foes.

2227.name: Depth of Elements
2227.description:
Build up elemental energy when you strike foes. Energy is consumed to imbue the jade sphere with different elements, creating combo fields and granting boons to allies in the area.
Gain access to Augments.

2250.name: Elemental Empowerment
2250.description: Gain Elemental Empowerment while in combat.

2231.name: Elemental Epitome
2231.description: Gain an aura based on your current attunement when you combo. Gain Elemental Empowerment when you grant yourself an aura. <c=@reminder>Auras can be gained this way once per attunement per interval.</c>

2230.name: Hardened Auras
2230.description: Damage reduction is increased when you grant yourself an aura. <c=@reminder>When this triggers, the durations of all stacks are refreshed. </c>

2252.name: Vicious Empowerment
2252.description: Gain Elemental Empowerment and might when you disable or immobilize a foe.

2224.name: Energized Elements
2224.description: Gain energy and boons when you switch attunements. <c=@reminder>Energy can only be gained while in combat. </c>

2247.name: Empowering Auras
2247.description: Gain increased outgoing damage when you grant yourself an aura. <c=@reminder>When this triggers, refresh the duration of all stacks. </c>

2249.name: Evasive Empowerment
2249.description: Gain Elemental Empowerment and vigor when evading an attack.

2234.name: Spectacular Sphere
2234.description: Your <c=@abilitytype>jade sphere</c> is larger and grants quickness and an additional boon based on your current attunement to nearby allies when activated.

2233.name: Elemental Synergy
2233.description: Gain a bonus effect when you finish a combo. <c=@reminder>Bonuses can trigger once per attunement per interval.</c>

2241.name: Empowered Empowerment
2241.description: Elemental Empowerment is more effective. While at maximum stacks of Elemental Empowerment, its effectiveness is increased further.

2251.name: Sphere Specialist
2251.description: Boons applied by your <c=@abilitytype>jade sphere</c> have increased duration. You can now gain energy while jade spheres are active.

2226.name: Gun X Sword
2226.description: Gain access to the <c=@abilitytype>Gunsaber</c> as an alternate weapon set, but lose the ability to swap to other weapon sets during combat. Adrenaline is replaced with <c=@abilitytype>flow</c>.

2242.name: Dragonscale Defense
2242.description: Gain boons when entering Dragon Trigger.

2236.name: Guns and Glory
2236.description: Gain ferocity for a short duration when you hit with an <c=@abilitytype>explosion</c>. This effect stacks duration.

2225.name: Unseen Sword
2225.description: Strike nearby enemies and gain increased flow rate when swapping to the gunsaber.

2260.name: Sharp as the Wind
2260.description: Load your gunsaber with ammunition that inflicts damaging conditions, changing its properties. Burn nearby enemies and gain increased flow rate when swapping to the gunsaber.

2237.name: River's Flow
2237.description: Load your gunsaber with ammunition that supports allies, changing its properties. Grant boons to nearby allies and gain positive flow when swapping to the gunsaber.

2253.name: Unshakable Mountain
2253.description: Grant barrier to nearby allies when you convert a certain amount of flow into charges.

2302.name: Fierce as Fire
2302.description: Gain increased strike and condition damage for each round of ammunition spent.

2303.name: Lush Forest
2303.description:
Using the first round of ammo on an ammunition skill reduces the recharge of all warrior skills.
Does not affect the recharge of Unsheathe Gunsaber, Sheathe Gunsaber, and Dragon Trigger.

2261.name: Immortal Dragon
2261.description: Dragon Slash heals you for a percentage of the damage dealt. Grant protection to allies whenever you convert a certain amount of flow into charges.

2239.name: Unyielding Dragon
2239.description: Dragon Slash becomes unblockable and ignores blindness. Gain might whenever you convert flow into charges.

2245.name: Daring Dragon
2245.description: Dragon Slash has a lower maximum charge level and consumes more flow per charge, but its effectiveness per charge is increased. Grant boons to nearby allies when you use Dragon Slash.

2262.name: Tenacious Ruin
2262.description: Instead of dodging, deliver a powerful blow from above, striking foes when you hit the ground.

2254.name: Balance in Discord
2254.description: Gain health and boons when swapping legends, or by using <c=@abilitytype>Alliance Tactics</c> while attuned to the Legendary Alliance.

2229.name: Empire Divided
2229.description: Gain increased power while above the health threshold. Gain increased healing power when below it.

2258.name: Leviathan Strength
2258.description: Deal increased damage while your endurance is not full.

2248.name: Amnesty of Shing Jea
2248.description:
Legendary Alliance abilities gain an additional bonus. Activating Energy Meld or Alliance Tactics grants both of these bonuses simultaneously at greater amounts to nearby allies.
Kurzick abilities grant regeneration.
Luxon abilities grant might.

2228.name: Redemptor's Sermon
2228.description: When you use a healing skill, heal allies in the area and grant them protection.

2259.name: Reaver's Curse
2259.description: Energy Meld's cooldown is reduced and it increases the effectiveness of your next dodge.

2243.name: Angsiyan's Trust
2243.description: Energy Meld no longer has an energy cost and grants energy when used in combat.

2255.name: Song of Arboreum
2255.description: Energy Meld grants more endurance and grants its endurance and vigor to nearby allies.

2257.name: Forerunner of Death
2257.description: Dodging now deals more damage but affects a smaller area. Outgoing strike damage is increased for a period of time upon impact.

2232.name: Vassals of the Empire
2232.description: Dodging now grants boons to allies and strikes foes when landing.

2238.name: Saint of zu Heltzer
2238.description: The affected area of your dodge is increased. You now heal allies in an area when you land instead of dealing damage. Outgoing healing is increased for a period of time upon landing.

2291.name: Mechanical Genius
2291.description:
Through your mechanical genius, you have utilized Canthan jade technology to build a customized battle mech that will fight at your side.
Your mech inherits a percentage of all of your combat attributes except precision, which is added to its own.
Your tool belt skills are replaced with Mech Commands, customized by your trait choices. Mech Commands take longer to recharge when using them far away from your mech.
Gain access to signet utility skills.

2266.name: Mech Fighter
2266.description: New combat subroutines enable your mech to use Rocket Punch when you activate Skill 3 on your equipped weapon. Your mech gains a greater percentage of your own toughness and vitality stats.

2267.name: Exigency Protocols
2267.description: When your mech is struck while under half health, it activates Exigency Protocols, gaining damage reduction and regeneration for a short duration. Regeneration boons you apply are stronger.

2282.name: Mech Arms: Single-Edge Cutters
2282.description: Unlocks the Mech Command skill Rolling Smash. Your mech's attacks apply bleeding. This effect may only affect a given target once per interval.

2296.name: Mech Arms: High-Impact Drivers
2296.description:
Unlocks the Mech Command skill Explosive Knuckle. Your mech's attacks now generate might for allies within a radius. This effect may only occur once per interval.

The mech does not count against the target count for this trait.

2279.name: Mech Arms: Jade Cannons
2279.description: Melee attacks become ranged, have an increased chance to critically hit, and apply vulnerability. Unlocks the Mech Command skill Spark Revolver.

2270.name: Mech Frame: Conductive Alloys
2270.description: Unlocks the Mech Command skill Discharge Array. Your mech gains a greater percentage of your own condition damage and expertise stats.

2276.name: Mech Frame: Channeling Conduits
2276.description: Unlocks the Mech Command skill Crisis Zone. When you or your mech apply barrier, also grant a boon to the affected target. Your mech gains a greater percentage of your own concentration and healing power stats.

2294.name: Mech Frame: Variable Mass Distributor
2294.description: Unlocks the Mech Command skill Core Reactor Shot. Your mech gains a greater percentage of your own precision stats.

2292.name: Mech Core: Jade Dynamo
2292.description: Unlocks the Mech Command skill Jade Mortar. Mech Command skills grant you quickness when used and have a reduced cooldown.

2281.name: Mech Core: Barrier Engine
2281.description:
Unlocks the Mech Command skill Barrier Burst. While in combat, your mech will automatically grant a small barrier each interval to nearby allies.

The mech does not count against the target count for this trait.

2298.name: Mech Core: J-Drive
2298.description:
Gain access to the Mech Command skill Sky Circus. While dismissed or away for repairs, your mech supports you with an occasional aerial bombardment.
Signet skills gain improved passive effects and continue to grant their passive bonuses while recharging.

2184.name: Specter
2184.description: Unlock scepter. <c=@abilitytype>Steal</c> becomes <c=@abilitytype>Siphon</c>. Gain access to shadow force through spending initiative, and gain access to the Shadow Shroud ability.

2272.name: Dark Sentry
2272.description:
Apply <c=@abilitytype>Rot Wallow Venom</c> to allies that you grant barrier to. Outgoing healing to allies is increased.
<c=@reminder>Rot Wallow Venom effect cannot apply to yourself.</c>

2280.name: Panaku's Ambition
2280.description:
Gain barrier when you strike foes with a stealth attack. When you apply stealth to allies, you also grant them barrier.
This effect can only be received once and will reset when stealth is removed.

2284.name: Second Opinion
2284.description: A portion of condition damage is converted to healing power. Gain condition damage, which is increased when wielding a scepter.

2299.name: Shallow Grave
2299.description: Transfer conditions to an enemy when targeting them with Siphon. Remove conditions from nearby allies and your targeted ally when targeting them with Siphon.

2275.name: Consume Shadows
2275.description: Gain stacks of Consume Shadows at regular intervals while in Shadow Shroud. Exiting Shadow Shroud consumes your remaining shadow force and heals allies based on the number of stacks you have gained. Allies that are fully healed receive the rest of the value in barrier.

2290.name: Larcenous Torment
2290.description:
Steal health and gain shadow force when you torment a foe.
Does not grant shadow force while in shroud.

2288.name: Amplified Siphoning
2288.description: Gain increased shadow force when hitting a foe with <c=@abilitytype>Siphon</c>. Grant increased barrier when targeting an ally.

2285.name: Traversing Dusk
2285.description: Heal allies in the area around you when you shadowstep. Gain shadow force for each ally in the radius. Wells grant resistance on their initial impact.

2264.name: Strength of Shadows
2264.description: Gain expertise based on a percentage of your vitality. Torment you inflict deals increased damage.

2300.name: Hungering Darkness
2300.description: While in shroud, transfer conditions from your tethered ally and cleanse conditions from yourself. Each condition removed in this fashion heals a percentage of your base health and grants your tethered ally barrier.

2289.name: Shadestep
2289.description: Shadow Shroud skills provide additional supportive effects to nearby allies and your tethered ally.

2268.name: Unleashed Power
2268.description: Gain access to <c=@abilitytype>Cantrips</c> and <c=@abilitytype>Unleash</c>. While your pet is unleashed, its skills are replaced with larger area-of-effect skills. Once per interval, <c=@abilitytype>Unleashed Ambush</c> skills become available for a short period of time after you unleash.

2286.name: Natural Fortitude
2286.description: Gain vitality. <c=@abilitytype>Unleashed Ambush</c> skills siphon health if they hit. Siphon healing is reduced for each target struck beyond the first. <c=@reminder> Cannot siphon the same target more than once per skill.</c>

2269.name: Vow of the Untamed
2269.description: Your outgoing strike damage is increased while you are unleashed. You take reduced damage from strikes while your pet is unleashed.

2297.name: Debilitating Blows
2297.description:
Disabling a foe applies conditions to that foe based on your current state.
Disables include stun, daze, knockback, pull, knockdown, sink, float, launch, taunt, and fear.

2277.name: Nature's Shield
2277.description: <c=@abilitytype>Cantrips</c> grant barrier to you and your pet.

2301.name: Blinding Outburst
2301.description: Venomous Outburst deals more damage and applies blindness in addition to its other effects. <c=@abilitytype>Unleashed Ambush</c> skills deal more damage.

2263.name: Enhancing Impact
2263.description:
Disabling a foe grants you boons based on your current state.
Disables include stun, daze, knockback, pull, knockdown, sink, float, launch, taunt, and fear.

2287.name: Cleansing Unleash
2287.description: Remove conditions when you or your pet unleash.

2278.name: Corrupting Vines
2278.description: Rending Vines converts boons into conditions instead of removing them. <c=@abilitytype>Unleashed Ambush</c> skills remove boons from enemies. <c=@reminder>Cannot affect enemies more than once per skill.</c>

2271.name: Let Loose
2271.description: <c=@abilitytype>Unleashed Ambush</c> skills grant boons to nearby allies. Refresh Unleashed Power when you swap weapons.

2283.name: Biorhythm
2283.description: When you or your pet unleash, gain biorythm every interval for a duration. When you reach the biorythm stack threshold, the next time you or your pet unleash, gain both bonuses from Vow of the Untamed.

2274.name: Ferocious Symbiosis
2274.description: You and your pet grant each other increased damage and movement speed when striking enemies. <c=@reminder>When this triggers, it refreshes the duration of all stacks.</c>

2386.name: Wandering Minstrel
2386.description:
Build up notes instead of summoning clones. Shatters are replaced by Instrument skills, which consume notes to continue playing. Gain access to Tales.

While out of combat, you will automatically generate a note every 10 seconds.

2424.name: Symphonic Resonance
2424.description: Instruments provide bonuses while playing in the background.

2374.name: Harmonize
2374.description: Gain a note when you use a <c=@abilitytype>phantasm</c> skill.

2427.name: Mayhem
2427.description: Flustering Flute now applies torment. Dodging reduces the recharge of Flustering Flute.

2326.name: Raconteur
2326.description: <c=@abilitytype>Tales</c> heal and grant protection to nearby allies.

2432.name: Syncopate
2432.description: Deafening Drum releases an additional quick wave after a delay. Deal damage to enemies you disable.

2343.name: Shredding
2343.description: Lively Lute fires an additional wave at your enemy. The lute's damage bonus is increased.

2367.name: Life of the Party
2367.description: Lively Lute and Crescendo grant boons to affected allies.

2422.name: Love Song
2422.description: Harmonious Harp's distortion lasts longer. Strike damage from nearby enemies is reduced while the harp is playing in the background.

2353.name: Fortissimo
2353.description: After using Crescendo, gain a note every interval for a duration. Gain increased attributes for each instrument you have playing.

2414.name: Call and Response
2414.description: When you use an instrument above the note threshold, create an afterimage that plays that instrument after a delay.

2441.name: Altered Chord
2441.description: Crescendo prompts your last-played instrument to take the spotlight, augmenting Crescendo's effects. Playing an instrument recharges Crescendo if a note was consumed.

2373.name: Rally the Valiant
2373.description: Gain access to chants and command skills. Gain motivation by using a chant or by using a burst skill while a refrain is active.

2418.name: Inspiring Implements
2418.description:
Gain concentration. Gain adrenaline and motivation when you swap weapons.
Motivation can only be gained while a refrain is active.

2340.name: Unyielding Resolve
2340.description: Strike and condition damage dealt to you is reduced for each point of motivation you have.

2345.name: Call to Action
2345.description: Gain motivation when you enter combat. If no refrains are active, automatically activate the refrain of Chant of Action.

2433.name: Calming Tongue
2433.description: Chant of Recuperation removes conditions from affected allies when activated.

2357.name: Liberating Liaise
2357.description: Chant of Freedom grants superspeed to affected allies when activated.

2385.name: Strengthening Stanzas
2385.description: Refrains grant bonus effects to you while they are active.

2426.name: Invigorating Tempo
2426.description: Heal yourself and gain adrenaline for each point of motivation spent.

2399.name: Reverberation
2399.description: Command echoes can trigger a second time.

2369.name: Feverish Pulse
2369.description: Using a chant reduces the recharge of your other chants and grants boons to affected allies.

2375.name: Brisk Pacing
2375.description: Deal increased damage based on your motivation level.

2428.name: Enduring Refrain
2428.description: Refrain effects of chants are stronger. Gain additional motivation when you activate a chant.

2377.name: Experimental Union
2377.description:
Through asuran ingenuity, you are host to a mercurial mold. You are able to command it using selectable morph skills that replace your toolbelt skills or even fully merge with it to evolve into a superior being.
Morph skills selected will alter the composition of the mercurial mold, changing the bonuses it grants you when you evolve.
Gain access to stance utility skills.

2389.name: Hybrid Vigor
2389.description: Gain vitality. Gain barrier when you use a <c=@abilitytype>morph</c> skill.

2356.name: Willing Host
2356.description: Using a <c=@abilitytype>morph</c> skill increases your damage for a duration.

2366.name: Stainless Steel
2366.description: Convert conditions to boons when you use a <c=@abilitytype>stance</c> skill or evolve.

2395.name: Innervating Alloy
2395.description: Heal every second while you have barrier. Heal when you evolve.

2434.name: Hardened Chrome
2434.description: <c=@abilitytype>Morph</c> skills and evolving grant protection to yourself.

2383.name: Carbolic Composition
2383.description: Amalgam skills inflict poison on hit. Poison you inflict lasts longer.

2420.name: Mercurial Tendencies
2420.description: Disabling an enemy reduces the cooldown of Evolve.

2349.name: Silver Lining
2349.description: Evolve no longer inherits bonuses from strains. <c=@abilitytype>Morph</c> skills grant their strain bonuses.

2406.name: Symbiotic Synergy
2406.description: Evolve recharges <c=@abilitytype>morph</c> skills. <c=@abilitytype>Morph</c> skills deal increased strike damage.

2387.name: New Genes
2387.description: <c=@abilitytype>Morph</c> skills grant boons to allies. Grant an additional boon based on which <c=@abilitytype>morph</c> skill was used.

2334.name: Double Helix
2334.description: Evolve has two charges and grants an increased attribute bonus.

2338.name: Spawning Power
2338.description: Death shroud is replaced with ritualist's shroud. Spirits created by shroud skills will persist until you exit shroud. After performing their initial attack, spirits will periodically attack enemies. Gain access to <c=@abilitytype>weapon spells</c>.

2371.name: Boon of Creation
2371.description:
Gain concentration. Gain life force when you summon a creature.
Spirits and minions are creatures.

2398.name: Charged Souls
2398.description:
Gain access to spirit innervation skills, allowing you to channel energy to your spirits for an additional effect.
Gain life force when you use an innervate skill.

2327.name: Wandering Spirits
2327.description: Spirits teleport to you before they perform their autoattack.

2378.name: Spirit's Gift
2378.description:
Heal nearby allies when you summon a creature.
Spirits and minions are creatures.

2339.name: Explosive Growth
2339.description:
When you summon a creature, deal damage to enemies around that creature.
Spirits and minions are creatures.

2384.name: Spirits' Remedy
2384.description:
Remove conditions from nearby allies when you summon a creature.
Spirits and minions are creatures.

2405.name: Empowering Spirits
2405.description: Grant boons to nearby allies when you summon a spirit.

2421.name: Spirit's Strength
2421.description: Your summoned creatures deal more damage and their healing is increased. <c=@reminder>Spirits and minions are creatures.</c>

2376.name: Wielder's Boon
2376.description: <c=@abilitytype>Weapon spells</c> remove conditions from affected allies. Affected allies receive the full benefit of <c=@abilitytype>weapon spells</c>.

2333.name: Lingering Spirits
2333.description: Gain a bonus for each active spirit. Spirits persist when exiting ritualist's shroud but continue to drain life force. Life force that is gained during this time will not be consumed by spirits.

2392.name: Soul Twisting
2392.description: The first <c=@abilitytype>spirit</c> skill you use when entering ritualist's shroud recharges instantly.

2403.name: Trinket Collector
2403.description: Steal is replaced with Skritt Swipe, allowing you to pilfer from enemies. Successfully pilfering grants one offensive and one defensive artifact. Only one artifact may be used each time you pilfer, and pilfering overrides any artifacts you already have.

2337.name: Magpie's Defense
2337.description: Grant yourself barrier when you use a healing or elite skill. <c=@reminder>The cooldowns for this trait are separate for healing and elite skills.</c>

2362.name: Enterprising Aristocrat
2362.description: Gain initiative and barrier whenever you use an artifact skill. You take reduced strike and condition damage whenever you have barrier.

2423.name: Card Swap
2423.description: Gain access to Reshuffle. Remove conditions from yourself whenever you reshuffle your artifacts or use an artifact skill.

2365.name: Repeat Ransacker
2365.description: Reduce the recharge of Skritt Swipe whenever you use an artifact.

2346.name: Prolific Plunderer
2346.description: Gain an additional artifact slot. Whenever you pilfer, you gain an additional, random artifact. You can use one additional artifact when you pilfer with Skritt Swipe.

2400.name: Scoundrel's Luck
2400.description: Gain Scoundrel's Luck whenever you use Skritt Swipe. Scoundrel's Luck allows you to use double-edge skills on cooldown without backfiring.

2431.name: Meticulous Custodian
2431.description: Your artifacts have increased effectiveness. Beneficial artifact effects last longer.

2350.name: Exhilarating Ephemera
2350.description: Gain increased damage for a period of time after using an artifact.

2409.name: Prodigious Pincher
2409.description: You pilfer after using a certain amount of initiative. This trait will override any existing artifacts when triggered.

2393.name: Possessive Hoarder
2393.description: Artifacts grant boons to allies when used. Offensive and defensive artifacts grant different boons. Barrier granted through Magpie's Defense and Enterprising Aristocrat is now also granted to allies as well.

2348.name: Combat High
2348.description: Gain Combat High when you use Skritt Swipe, increasing your outgoing strike and condition damage. Lose stacks of Combat High every interval.

2359.name: Teachings of the Tengu
2359.description:
Mastery of tengu wind magic allows you to conjure the Cyclone Bow at will. Using arrow-consuming skills grants Wind Force. After you reach the Wind Force threshold, you are able to use Hawkeye. Gain access to Squalls.
Using Cyclone Bow skills consumes arrows. You generate arrows every interval.

2363.name: Bird of Prey
2363.description: Strike damage is increased when you have swiftness or superspeed. Swiftness is more effective.

2341.name: Jetstream
2341.description: Your base movement speed is increased. Hawkeye grants superspeed.

2402.name: Joy of Movement
2402.description: <c=@abilitytype>Squalls</c> remove movement-impairing conditions and a damaging condition.

2370.name: Feel the Rush
2370.description: Movement skills grant you swiftness and endurance.

2360.name: Wuthering Wind
2360.description: After using Bluster, your pet's next attack creates a damaging swell of wind around its target.

2408.name: Flock Together
2408.description: Feathered pets have increased strike damage and health. <c=@abilitytype>Beast</c> skills grant quickness around the ranger.

2413.name: Perilous Skies
2413.description: Quarry's Peril is replaced by Pelt.

2396.name: Thrill of the Catch
2396.description: Restore arrows when you or your pet disable an enemy.

2425.name: Cloudburst
2425.description: Quarry's Peril and Supersonic Arrow reset the cooldown of Bluster. When you use Bluster or Hawkeye, grant boons to nearby allies.

2336.name: Gale Force
2336.description: Wind Force grants stacking increased movement speed and damage. When you use Hawkeye, convert these into a stronger bonus for a duration.

2372.name: Shrike
2372.description:
After a number of missile hits, release a volley of arrows at your target and gain an arrow.
Missiles from this trait do not count toward its next trigger.

2364.name: Enigmatic Connection
2364.description: Gain access to Release Potential, Cosmic Wisdom, and Legendary Entity Stance. The effects of Release Potential and Cosmic Wisdom change depending on which legend you are currently invoking. Gain affinity while using legend skills, which increases the effectiveness of Release Potential. Gain additional affinity when using legend skills above the threshold and while channeling an upkeep skill.

2331.name: Bolstered Bonds
2331.description: Gain attributes based on your equipped legends. Those attributes are increased further when Cosmic Wisdom is active.

2440.name: Numinous Gift
2440.description: The third minor traits of other specializations you equip have improved effectiveness. Gain might and additional boons when you use Cosmic Wisdom, depending on which legends you have equipped.

2390.name: Conductive Armaments
2390.description: Gain affinity when using a weapon skill that costs energy.

2355.name: Shared Wisdom
2355.description: Grant boons to allies whenever you use a Legendary Entity Skill, depending on which skill was used.

2407.name: Lingering Determination
2407.description: Gain affinity when you invoke a different legend.

2411.name: Kinetic Insight
2411.description: The recharge of Release Potential skills is reduced. The effectiveness of Release Potential skills are increased as if you had two additional points of affinity, up to a maximum of five.

2358.name: Expanded Consciousness
2358.description: Heal and gain endurance whenever you gain affinity. Additionally, gain energy when you reach maximum affinity.

2416.name: Ethereal Purification
2416.description: Lose conditions when activating Cosmic Wisdom and at a set interval while Cosmic Wisdom is active.

2429.name: Mistfire
2429.description: Apply conditions to enemies when you disable them. Perform an additional strike when using Cosmic Wisdom that damages and burns enemies.

2379.name: Enhanced Embodiment
2379.description: Reduce the recharge of invoking legends in combat. Invoking legends while Cosmic Wisdom is active extends its duration.

2352.name: Found Purpose
2352.description: Trigger the active portion of Numinous Gift when you invoke a legend while in combat. Triggering Numinous Gift grants boons to allies in an area around you, depending on which legends you have equipped.

2344.name: Evocation
2344.description:
Select an element to specialize in, greatly reducing its recharge time and gaining a familiar of that element. The familiar's basic skill charges as you use weapon skills, charging more rapidly when you use a weapon skill of its element. Using the familiar's basic skill three times will enable its empowered skill.
Gain access to meditation skills.

2382.name: Enhanced Potency
2382.description: Improve a boon based on your familiar.

2351.name: Familiar's Prowess
2351.description: Gain a temporary bonus after using a <c=@abilitytype>familiar</c> skill.

2391.name: Fiery Might
2391.description: Deal increased strike damage to burning foes.

2354.name: Spirit's Succor
2354.description: Heal yourself when you use a <c=@abilitytype>familiar</c> skill.

2380.name: Familiar's Blessing
2380.description: Grant boons to nearby allies when you use a <c=@abilitytype>familliar</c> skill.

2438.name: Elemental Dynamo
2438.description: Gain one <c=@abilitytype>familiar</c> charge when attuning to your selected element.

2335.name: Galvanic Enchantment
2335.description: After you use a <c=@abilitytype>familiar</c> skill, your next strikes create an arc of chain lightning. Chain lightning created by evoker skills inflicts burning.

2436.name: Elemental Balance
2436.description: Every second time you enter your selected attunement, the next elementalist weapon skill you use will recharge faster.

2437.name: Specialized Elements
2437.description: You cannot leave your selected attunement. Your familiar's basic skill charges more quickly, and activating it recharges your weapon skills by a small amount. Activating your familiar's empowered skill recharges your weapon skills and triggers traits as if you entered the attunement.

2381.name: Luminary
2381.description: Harness light and flame to bolster yourself and allies or disrupt your enemies. Gain access to Radiant Forge and <c=@abilitytype>stance</c> skills.

2394.name: Light's Gift
2394.description: Gain vitality. Grant Luminary's Blessing to allies when you equip a radiant weapon.

2435.name: Radiant Armaments
2435.description: Gain a bonus based on your equipped radiant weapon. This bonus lingers for a period of time after exiting Radiant Forge.

2410.name: Shimmering Stances
2410.description: <c=@abilitytype>Stances</c> grant protection to affected allies and blind affected enemies.

2417.name: Resolute Blessing
2417.description: Luminary's Blessing now also reduces incoming condition damage.

2329.name: Persistent Blessing
2329.description: Refresh the duration of your Luminary's Blessing and trigger its healing when you exit Radiant Forge.

2330.name: Resplendent Weaponry
2330.description: Grant boons to nearby allies when you equip a radiant weapon.

2401.name: Purging Light
2401.description: Remove conditions from nearby allies when you grant yourself light aura. Gain light aura when you use a healing skill.

2419.name: Empowered Armaments
2419.description: Gain increased strike damage when you equip a radiant weapon.

2368.name: Illuminating Inspiration
2368.description: Reduce the recharge of your <c=@abilitytype>virtue</c> skills when you equip a radiant weapon.

2328.name: Sovereign of Light
2328.description: Gain light aura when entering Radiant Forge. Luminary skills detonate light aura, damaging enemies and healing allies.

2388.name: Master-at-Arms
2388.description: Using a <c=@abilitytype>virtue</c> skill recharges radiant weapon skills. Justice recharges hammer, Resolve recharges staff, and Courage recharges sword and shield.
